description: Look up a specific section of the Magic: The Gathering Comprehensive Rules by section number (e.g., "702", "702.1") or search rules text. Use this when a user asks about specific game rules, rule interactions, or needs the official rule text. Returns the rule and its subsections.

query.description: Text to search for across all rule titles and text (case-insensitive).

section.description: Rule section number to look up (e.g. "702" or "702.1"). Returns exact match plus all subsections.

name: lookup_rule
